thesis.en: More useful inference and parallel agents could raise compute and memory demand, even as each task gets cheaper. Total paid workload must grow faster than efficiency improves.
thesis.zh: 有效推理与并行智能体可能拉动算力和存储，即使单次任务更便宜；前提是付费总工作量增长超过效率提升。

bottleneck.en: Useful workload → paid usage → hardware utilization
bottleneck.zh: 有效任务 → 付费使用 → 硬件利用率

confirm.en: Over the next two reported quarters, compare AI revenue, margins and customer spending with the prior guidance.
confirm.zh: 接下来两个已披露季度，核对 AI 收入、利润率和客户开支能否兑现此前指引。

invalidate.en: Spending remains high while utilization, pricing or cash generation weaken; customers reduce orders.
invalidate.zh: 开支高企，但利用率、定价或现金创造能力恶化；客户削减订单。

slow.en: Watch utilization first. Falling unit costs can reduce hardware spending before new uses absorb supply.
slow.zh: 先看利用率。单位成本下降可能先压低硬件支出，新用途未必及时吸收供给。

base.en: Track paid inference growth and margins together. Favor demonstrable economics over capacity announcements.
base.zh: 同时看付费推理增量与利润率，优先验证实际经济回报。

fast.en: Capacity and memory become constraints, but customer concentration and forward valuation can still hurt returns.
fast.zh: 容量与内存成为约束，但客户集中与提前透支的估值仍会损害回报。

thesis.en: If compute use expands, physical power delivery and heat removal can limit deployment. This is our economic inference, not a stock recommendation from the speakers.
thesis.zh: 若计算需求扩张，供电和散热可能约束部署。这是本站的产业推演，不是视频嘉宾推荐这些股票。

bottleneck.zh: 订单 → 设施接通 → 回款

confirm.en: At the next two reports, verify backlog conversion, cancellation rates where disclosed, and cash conversion.
confirm.zh: 后续两次财报检查积压订单兑现、已披露的取消情况和现金回收。

invalidate.en: Backlogs rise but deliveries and cash flow stall, or data-center customers delay projects.
invalidate.zh: 积压订单上升，但交付和现金流停滞，或数据中心客户推迟项目。

slow.en: Order quality and working capital matter more than announced capacity.
slow.zh: 订单质量和营运资金比宣布的产能更重要。

base.en: Watch delivery schedules and whether revenue converts into cash.
base.zh: 关注交付时间及收入能否转成现金。

fast.en: Grid connections and cooling constrain deployment; shortage does not make any valuation reasonable.
fast.zh: 接电与散热约束部署，但短缺不意味着任何估值都合理。

name.en: Enterprise agents that earn their keep
name.zh: 能创造回报的企业智能体

thesis.en: Distribution, workflow data and reliable recovery can turn model capability into paid work. Existing software benefits only if new usage exceeds price and seat erosion.
thesis.zh: 分发、工作流数据和可靠恢复，才能把模型能力转成付费工作。已有软件只有在新收入超过降价和席位流失时才真正受益。

bottleneck.zh: 可靠完成 → 续约 → 增量利润

confirm.en: Check disclosed paid adoption, renewals and incremental AI revenue against serving and review costs.
confirm.zh: 核对披露的付费采用、续约与增量 AI 收入，扣除服务及复核成本。

invalidate.en: Demos grow while paid retention stays weak, or agent revenue merely replaces higher-margin seat revenue.
invalidate.zh: 演示增加而付费留存弱，或智能体收入只是替代利润率更高的席位收入。

slow.en: Human-supervised workflows may monetize sooner than autonomous workers.
slow.zh: 需要人监督的工作流可能比完全自主员工更早变现。

base.en: Track specific paid tasks and renewals instead of counting launched agents.
base.zh: 看具体付费任务和续约，不数发布了多少智能体。

fast.en: Usage can accelerate, but incumbents may lose seat pricing and face new competitors.
fast.zh: 使用量可能加速，但老厂商也可能失去席位定价权并遇到新对手。

thesis.en: Agents acting across systems create permission, monitoring and incident-response needs. Demand for safeguards does not guarantee a separate paid market for every vendor.
thesis.zh: 跨系统行动的智能体带来权限、监控和响应需求；防护需求不保证每家厂商都能形成独立付费市场。

bottleneck.en: Permission controls → safe deployment → paid contracts
bottleneck.zh: 权限控制 → 安全部署 → 付费合同

confirm.en: Look for attributable paid deployments, organic security growth and renewal evidence; separate acquisitions.
confirm.zh: 寻找可归因的付费部署、安全业务有机增长和续约证据，剔除并购影响。

invalidate.en: Controls become free bundles, adoption stalls or losses from incidents exceed the expected business value.
invalidate.zh: 控制能力被免费捆绑、采用停滞，或事故损失超过预期业务价值。

slow.en: Reliability and compliance remain adoption bottlenecks even if model progress slows.
slow.zh: 即使模型进展放缓，可靠性与合规仍可能阻碍采用。

base.en: Verify customers pay for controls rather than receiving them in existing bundles.
base.zh: 确认客户为控制能力额外付费，而非只获得已有套餐的附赠。

fast.en: More autonomous activity increases the need for control; verify who captures the spending.
fast.zh: 自主活动增加会提高控制需求，但要确认谁真正获得支出。

thesis.en: Interactive simulation could support creation, training and robotics. A technical leap still needs reliable real-world transfer and paying users.
thesis.zh: 交互仿真可能服务创作、训练和机器人；技术突破仍需可靠的现实迁移和付费用户。

bottleneck.en: Simulation → real-world transfer → repeat paid use
bottleneck.zh: 仿真 → 现实迁移 → 持续付费

confirm.en: Require repeat external use, comparable real-world evaluations and separately evidenced economics before upgrading the thesis.
confirm.zh: 升级判断前，需要持续外部使用、可比较的现实测试和单独可核查的商业回报。

invalidate.en: Simulation improves while real-world reliability, costs or commercial retention fail to improve.
invalidate.zh: 仿真变强，但现实可靠性、成本或商业留存没有改善。

slow.en: Keep this as a research option; avoid assuming a near-term earnings contribution.
slow.zh: 保持远期观察，不假设短期利润贡献。

base.en: Advance only when simulation benefits a measured real task.
base.zh: 只有仿真对可测量的现实任务产生收益，才推进判断。

fast.en: New markets may form, but the first technical winner need not be the best stock investment.
fast.zh: 新市场可能形成，但技术领先者未必就是最好的股票投资。

fact.en: Reported Data Center revenue growth; this establishes current demand, not a cheap share price.
fact.zh: 已披露数据中心收入增长；说明当前需求，不说明股票便宜。

check.en: Data Center growth, gross margin, customer concentration and cash conversion.
check.zh: 数据中心增速、毛利率、客户集中度、现金回收。

risk.en: Custom chips, export limits and customers building ahead of demand.
risk.zh: 定制芯片替代、出口限制、客户提前扩建。

fact.en: Reported growth in custom AI accelerators and networking revenue. Customer concentration still matters.
fact.zh: 披露定制 AI 加速器与网络收入增长，仍需检查客户集中度。

check.en: AI revenue, next-quarter guidance, program timing and customer breadth.
check.zh: AI 收入、下季度指引、项目交付节奏、客户广度。

risk.en: Few large customers; internal chip programs can shift spending.
risk.zh: 少数大客户占比较高，自研项目可能改变支出。

fact.en: The September 30 release reports strong AI-led demand and record results. Peak earnings are not normalized earnings.
fact.zh: 9 月 30 日公告披露 AI 需求与创纪录业绩；高景气利润不能直接当作常态利润。

role.zh: 高带宽内存与存储容量

check.en: HBM mix, DRAM supply, inventory days, capital spending and through-cycle cash flow.
check.zh: HBM 占比、DRAM 供给、库存天数、资本开支、跨周期现金流。

risk.en: Memory supply can overshoot demand; falling prices compress peak margins.
risk.zh: 存储扩产可能超过需求，价格回落压缩峰值利润。

fact.en: Reported rising data-center demand and raised full-year guidance. Orders still need to convert to cash.
fact.zh: 披露数据中心需求增长并上调全年指引；订单仍需兑现成现金。

check.en: Orders, backlog conversion, organic growth, working capital and free cash flow.
check.zh: 订单、积压订单转收入、有机增长、营运资金、自由现金流。

risk.en: Construction delays, order cancellations and capacity expansion costs.
risk.zh: 建设延期、订单取消、扩产成本。

fact.en: Reported growth in electrical orders and backlog; data centers are one driver, not the whole company.
fact.zh: 披露电气业务订单与积压订单增长；数据中心是驱动之一，并非整个公司。

check.en: Electrical orders, book-to-bill, delivery capacity and segment margins.
check.zh: 电气订单、订单收入比、交付能力、分部利润率。

risk.en: Industrial cyclicality, grid delays and a valuation that already assumes growth.
risk.zh: 工业周期、电网延期、估值已提前反映增长。

fact.en: Reported Azure growth and paid Copilot adoption. Revenue must be weighed against infrastructure spending.
fact.zh: 披露 Azure 增长与 Copilot 付费采用；收入需与基础设施支出一起评估。

check.en: Azure growth, paid usage, AI monetization, capex and free cash flow after investment.
check.zh: Azure 增速、付费使用、AI 变现、资本开支与投资后的自由现金流。

risk.en: High capital intensity; monetization can lag infrastructure spending.
risk.zh: 资本密集，变现可能落后于基建投入。

fact.en: Reported AI annual contract value and subscription growth. Contract value is not recognized revenue.
fact.zh: 披露 AI 年度合同价值与订阅增长；合同价值不等于已确认收入。

role.zh: 企业流程与智能体编排

check.en: AI contract conversion, cRPO, renewals and net gains after seat cannibalization.
check.zh: AI 合同兑现、cRPO、续约、扣除席位替代后的净增量。

risk.en: Agents can replace seats as well as sell new products; valuation sensitivity.
risk.zh: 智能体也可能替代原有席位，且估值敏感。

fact.en: Reports security platform revenue and ARR. These do not isolate revenue from AI-agent security.
fact.zh: 披露安全平台收入与 ARR，但不能据此分离 AI 智能体安全收入。

role.zh: 身份、云与 AI 安全

check.en: Organic next-generation security ARR, GAAP profit, cash flow and acquisition effects.
check.zh: 下一代安全 ARR 的有机增长、GAAP 利润、现金流及并购影响。

risk.en: Bundling by cloud vendors, dilution and acquisitions obscuring organic growth.
risk.zh: 云厂商捆绑、股权稀释、并购掩盖有机增长。

fact.en: DeepMind demonstrated an interactive world model. This is dated technical evidence, not verified world-model revenue.
fact.zh: DeepMind 展示过交互世界模型；这是带日期的技术证据，不是已核实的世界模型收入。

check.en: External paid adoption, cost per useful session and real-world transfer tests.
check.zh: 外部付费采用、每次有效交互成本、向现实任务迁移的测试。

risk.en: A convincing demo may not produce a profitable business; Alphabet is not a pure-play.
risk.zh: 演示可能无法变成盈利业务，Alphabet 也并非该路线的纯标的。

summary.en: Almeida argues that AI can strengthen existing software by becoming a small, programmable part of it.
summary.zh: Almeida 认为，AI 可以成为软件中可编程的小部件，增强已有软件的能力。

limit.en: A product thesis does not establish adoption, reliability or an advantage for every software business.
limit.zh: 产品方向并不能证明已经普及、足够可靠，或对每一家软件公司都有利。

summary.en: Karpathy describes agents as a decade-long engineering effort, pointing to gaps including continual learning.
summary.zh: Karpathy 将智能体描述为一项可能持续十年的工程，提到持续学习等尚待解决的问题。

limit.en: This is a view recorded in October 2025, not a current capability test or a resolved AGI deadline.
limit.zh: 这是 2025 年 10 月的观点，不是当前能力测评，也不是已经裁决的 AGI 时间表。

summary.en: Amodei expects very powerful AI within a few years and discusses how capability may spread through the economy.
summary.zh: Amodei 预期未来几年会出现非常强大的 AI，并讨论能力如何扩散到经济活动中。

limit.en: A lab leader’s expectation is not independent confirmation. Technical capability and widespread adoption are different questions.
limit.zh: 实验室负责人的预期不是独立验证；技术能力与大规模采用是两个不同的问题。

summary.en: Weinstein emphasizes agents retrying and debugging after problems, beyond merely starting a task.
summary.zh: Weinstein 强调智能体遇到问题后的重试与调试能力，而不只是能启动任务。

limit.en: A vendor’s description is not an independent comparison across tasks.
limit.zh: 供应商描述不等于覆盖不同任务的独立对照测评。

summary.en: Shihipar discusses software that users can continually reshape with agents.
summary.zh: Shihipar 讨论用户借助智能体不断调整软件的可能性。

limit.en: A customization vision is not evidence that ongoing maintenance disappears.
limit.zh: 可定制的愿景不代表持续维护会消失。

summary.en: Huang argues that agentic systems should operate with restrictive rights.
summary.zh: Huang 主张智能体系统应在受限制的权限下运行。

limit.en: Restricting access reduces exposure but cannot establish that an entire system is safe.
limit.zh: 限制访问可减少暴露面，但不能证明整个系统已经安全。

summary.en: Huang frames AI safety as an engineering problem that can be addressed through system design.
summary.zh: Huang 将 AI 安全视为可以通过系统设计处理的工程问题。

limit.en: This is an executive’s position, not proof that all safety problems are solved.
limit.zh: 这是管理者的立场，不是所有安全问题已经解决的证明。

summary.en: Atallah and Midha challenge the idea of a single model winning every use case.
summary.zh: Atallah 与 Midha 质疑由单一模型赢下所有用途的想法。

limit.en: A marketplace perspective does not establish the best model for your task.
limit.zh: 模型市场参与者的看法，不能直接决定哪个模型最适合你的任务。

summary.en: The discussion highlights distribution and access as important parts of the AI market.
summary.zh: 这场讨论将分发与访问能力视为 AI 市场的重要部分。

limit.en: Distribution is a business thesis, not evidence of demand or a durable advantage.
limit.zh: 这是商业方向判断，不能证明付费需求或长期优势已经存在。

summary.en: Germanidis discusses real-time video and world models as a direction for interactive experiences.
summary.zh: Germanidis 讨论实时视频与世界模型通向交互体验的方向。

limit.en: A research direction does not establish production reliability or demand.
limit.zh: 研究方向不能证明生产可靠性或市场需求。

summary.en: Germanidis emphasizes references, steerability and iteration within creative workflows.
summary.zh: Germanidis 强调创作流程中的参考、可控性与反复调整。

limit.en: Creative controls do not guarantee originality, consistency or a commercially usable result.
limit.zh: 创作控制能力不能保证原创性、一致性或商业可用性。

summary.en: Brown explores parallel agent work and the challenges of coordinating many contributors.
summary.zh: Brown 探讨智能体并行工作，以及协调多个参与者的挑战。

limit.en: Research examples do not establish gains for every workflow or agent count.
limit.zh: 研究例子不能证明所有流程都能通过增加智能体获益。

summary.en: Brown considers how more capable models might organize increasingly large groups of agents.
summary.zh: Brown 推测更强的模型可能组织越来越大的智能体群体。

limit.en: This is a forward-looking scenario, not evidence of autonomous firms operating reliably.
limit.zh: 这是前瞻性情景，不能证明自主公司已经可靠运转。

summary.en: Kvist argues that trust and accountability can constrain adoption even when AI capabilities improve.
summary.zh: Kvist 认为，即使 AI 能力提升，信任与责任问题仍可能限制采用。

limit.en: An assurance vendor’s perspective does not prove its service resolves every adoption barrier.
limit.zh: 保障服务供应商的观点，不能证明其服务能解决所有采用障碍。

summary.en: Kvist emphasizes testing failure cases beyond a successful demonstration.
summary.zh: Kvist 强调在成功演示之外检验失败案例。

limit.en: Passing a test set does not guarantee safe behavior outside its coverage.
limit.zh: 通过某套测试不能保证覆盖之外的行为也可靠。

summary.en: The panel debates whether research and engineering bottlenecks could constrain recursive AI improvement.
summary.zh: 嘉宾讨论研究和工程瓶颈是否会限制 AI 的递归自我改进，并存在分歧。

views.speaker: John Schulman · Beren Millidge · Charlie O’Neill

limit.en: The participants disagree; this is not a shared timetable or a settled result.
limit.zh: 参与者并未形成一致时间表，这也不是已经解决的结论。

summary.en: The discussion examines the difficulty of transferring simulated success to complex real-world tasks.
summary.zh: 这场讨论检视模拟中的成功迁移到复杂现实任务时面临的困难。

views.speaker: John Schulman · Beren Millidge · Charlie O’Neill

limit.en: A simulation gap can vary by task; it does not show that all benchmarks are useless.
limit.zh: 迁移差距因任务而异，不能据此认定所有基准都没有用。

changes.zh: 建立五条路线与九只美股观察清单。分离嘉宾观点、产业推演和公司证据；全部估值仍待逐股核对。
changes.en: Established five routes and nine US-listed watch candidates. Speaker views, economic hypotheses and company evidence are separate; valuation remains unassessed.
